content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the removal of the call to `g_dbus_interface_skeleton_flush()` when the function `r_installer_set_operation()` was moved. This resulted in property updates not being flushed to the D-Bus interface, leading to notifications being aggregated in an idle loop. Consequently, if multiple updates occurred before a notification was sent, some updates were lost, particularly affecting the installation status messages that dropped sub-steps from the report.
